why: Not refuted on its substance; one secondary clause is wrong and is corrected below. (1) DOC: curl -sL of https://code.claude.com/docs/en/output-styles.md returns the sentence VERBATIM as the first sentence of line 21. The whole line is two sentences and the second REINFORCES rather than reverses: '**Proactive**: Claude executes immediately, makes reasonable assumptions instead of pausing for routine decisions, and prefers action over planning. This is stronger autonomous-execution guidance than [auto mode](/docs/en/permission-modes#eliminate-prompts-with-auto-mode) applies, and it works without changing your permission mode, so you still see permission prompts before tools run.' Line 19 states 'There are three additional built-in output styles'; :21 Proactive, :23 Explanatory, :25 Learning (with the `TODO(human)` marker). The page is row 136 of scripts/claude-doc-pages.tsv, so it is a Claude contract page. (2) CODE: packages/shared/src/prompts/output-styles.ts:83-128 is BUILTIN_OUTPUT_STYLE_DEFINITIONS and contains exactly four entries with ids default/concise/explanatory/reviewer (labels Default, Concise, Explanatory, Reviewer). :562 is `const NO_OUTPUT_STYLE: OutputStyleComposition = { prompt: '', keepCodingInstructions: true }` and :570 returns it whenever resolveOutputStyle finds nothing. Both cited line numbers are exact. `grep -a` over packages/ and apps/ (excluding node_modules and dist) finds no Proactive or Learning built-in style and no TODO(human) marker convention anywhere; the only 'Proactive' hit is unrelated prose in system.ts:1149 about Mermaid diagrams. (3) LAYER UP / LAYER DOWN: no sibling subsystem supplies the missing styles. The Claude backend does not pass an outputStyle through to the SDK - system.ts:438-450 composes our own block and appends it to the claude_code preset, and grep for outputStyle across packages/shared/src/agent returns only base-agent.ts plugin-style plumbing. So the absence of Proactive/Learning is real end to end. NOT one of the nine dated owner decisions in 2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md section 3 (that list is seatbelt wildcard, availableModels, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, plugins/hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, SessionMirrorStore.delete, MirrorSessionKey.subpath, listSessionSummaries). NOT a rebrand or product-scope difference either: it has nothing to do with the dropped Claude/ChatGPT subscription flows, the corporate gateway, or NESSY_ naming - Concise and Reviewer are Nessy-authored styles, not renamed Claude ones. Registration confirmed: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-29-deviation-register.md:224 and :225 are exactly these two rows, harvested from docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-29-output-style-contract.md:194-195, both categorised 'documented, not implemented' - a recorded gap, not a decided-against one. WHAT IS WRONG: the consequence clause 'a .md authored against the documented set names a style that does not resolve'. A user-authored .md DOES resolve. discoverCustomOutputStyles is name-agnostic and registers any .md under the user (CONFIG_DIR/output-styles), workspace or trusted-project directory as `custom:<slug>`, so dropping a Proactive.md or Learning.md there yields a working, selectable style; resolveOutputStyle (:526-542) only falls through to NO_OUTPUT_STYLE for a stored id that matches no built-in, plugin or custom style. Reaching the silent 'add nothing' path therefore requires hand-writing an unresolvable id into config.json:outputStyleId, and that key is a private Nessy field written by one RPC handler - we do not read the documented `outputStyle` settings key at all (itself a separate register row at :227), so a settings file authored against the docs is ignored outright rather than silently no-opped.
correctedState: Our built-in output styles are Default, Concise, Explanatory and Reviewer (packages/shared/src/prompts/output-styles.ts:83-128). Claude's documented set is Default plus Proactive (output-styles.md:21), Explanatory (:23) and Learning (:25). Proactive - the autonomy posture the page calls stronger than auto mode and independent of permission mode - and Learning, with its TODO(human) marker convention, have no Nessy equivalent on any backend: the Claude backend appends our own style block to the claude_code preset (prompts/system.ts:438-450) rather than selecting an SDK built-in. Concise and Reviewer are Nessy-authored and have no Claude counterpart, and our Explanatory shares the name but not the 'Insights' convention (separate register row :226). The consequence is narrower than claimed: a user-authored .md does resolve, because discoverCustomOutputStyles registers any .md in the user, workspace or trusted-project output-styles directory as custom:<slug> regardless of name, so a hand-written Proactive.md works. The NO_OUTPUT_STYLE fallback at :562 is reached only by a stored config.json:outputStyleId that matches nothing, and since that key is private to Nessy and written by a single RPC handler, a settings file authored against the documented `outputStyle` key is ignored rather than silently reduced to 'add nothing'. Registered as deviation-register :224 and :225, category 'documented, not implemented'.
